note: 自建句式库：按「章节 × 写作意图」组织的英文模板，非任何机构资料的复制。{花括号} 处替换为你的内容。

entries.zh: 交代领域背景与重要性
en: {Field} has attracted increasing attention because {reason}.
Understanding {phenomenon} is important for {application}.
{Phenomenon} plays a central role in {context}, yet {open question}.
entries.caution: 背景最多两句；不要在这里展开文献评述。

entries.zh: 点明本文要解决的问题
en: This study aims to determine whether {X} affects {Y}.
We address the question of how {X} changes under {condition}.
Here we ask which factors control {X} in {setting}.
entries.caution: 一个问题即可；多个目标意味着多个贡献，说服力会下降。

en: We {method} on {data}, using {tool} to measure {quantity}.
A {design} was used to compare {group A} with {group B}.
The model was trained on {n} samples and evaluated by {metric}.
entries.caution: 方法只写读者理解结果所必需的部分。

entries.zh: 报告具体结果（必须带数字或方向）
en: {Metric} increased from {a} to {b} ({p}%), a {size} improvement over {baseline}.
Under {condition}, {quantity} was {value} times higher than in the control.
We found no evidence that {X} affects {Y}.
entries.caution: 「效果更好」不算结果；给出数值、方向与对照。

en: These results are limited to {setting}; generalization to {other setting} remains to be tested.
The analysis covers {n} cases and should not be extrapolated to {population}.
entries.caution: 一句即可，不要写成道歉。

en: These findings suggest that {X} is a viable route to {goal}.
Our results provide a basis for {application} under {condition}.
entries.caution: 结论必须被结果句直接支撑，不得外推。

entries.zh: 宣称主题的中心性（CARS Move 1）
en: {Topic} is central to {field} because {reason}.
The ability to {capability} underlies many applications in {field}.
Recent years have seen growing interest in {topic}.
entries.caution: 要大胆但要有据；空喊「具有重要意义」最容易被审稿人划掉。

entries.zh: 综述前人工作（分类而不要罗列）
en: Prior work has approached {problem} in two main ways: {approach A} and {approach B}.
{Author} showed that {finding}; subsequent studies extended this to {setting}.
These methods perform well when {condition}, but degrade when {other condition}.
entries.caution: 按方法分类；每类都要落到「在本场景下不够用」。

en: However, few studies have examined {X} under {condition}.
It remains unclear whether {X} generalizes beyond {setting}.
This raises the question of how {X} responds to {Y}.
These approaches assume {assumption}, which may not hold when {condition}.
entries.caution: 空白必须能由你的结果填上；否则整篇论文会失去支点。

en: In this study, we test the hypothesis that {X} increases with {Y}.
We therefore set out to determine whether {X} can be predicted from {Y}.
To address this gap, we {method} and compare it against {baseline}.
entries.caution: 假设要可被数据证伪，避免「验证其优越性」这类不可证伪表述。

en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section 2 describes {X}; Section 3 reports {Y}.
We first describe {X}, then present {Y}, and finally discuss {Z}.
entries.caution: 「本节介绍……下节介绍……」是最无聊的段落，宁可并入上一段。

en: Data were collected from {source} between {period} and filtered by {criteria}.
The dataset comprises {n} samples, of which {m} were excluded because {reason}.
All procedures were approved by {committee} (approval no. {id}).
entries.caution: 排除标准必须写，否则结果不可复现。

en: Experiments were performed on {platform} with {specification} at {condition}.
Models were implemented in {framework} (version {v}) and trained for {epochs} epochs.
Each condition was repeated {n} times, and the mean ± SD is reported.
entries.caution: 版本号与重复次数是复现的关键，别省。

en: The procedure consisted of three steps: {A}, {B}, and {C}.
Samples were first {action}, then {action}, and finally {action}.
After {step}, the output was passed to {module} for {purpose}.
entries.caution: 用过去时；按时间顺序，一步一段。

en: We used {method} because it is robust to {condition}.
{Metric} was chosen to capture {property}; higher values indicate {meaning}.
Differences were assessed with {test} at a significance level of α = {alpha}.
entries.caution: 选择方法的理由要写，评审常问「为什么不用 X」。

en: All analyses were performed in {software}; reported values are mean ± SD.
Multiple comparisons were corrected using {method}.
Effect sizes are reported as {measure} with 95% confidence intervals.
entries.caution: 只报 p 值不报效应量，是常见退稿理由。

en: Figure {n} shows that {X} increased with {Y}.
As expected, {group A} differed from {group B} in {measure}.
Consistent with {hypothesis}, {observation}.
entries.caution: Results 只陈述，不加「因为」「说明」。

en: The mean {measure} was {value} (SD = {sd}, n = {n}).
{A} was {p}% higher than {B} ({a} vs {b}).
The effect remained significant after controlling for {covariate}.
entries.caution: 必须给单位与样本量。

en: Compared with {baseline}, {our method} improved {metric} by {p}%.
{Method A} outperformed {method B} on {metric}, but required {cost}.
The difference between {A} and {B} was not statistically significant.
entries.caution: 对照要交代公平性（同数据、同预算）。

en: {Measure} increased monotonically with {X} up to {threshold}, after which it plateaued.
The trend reversed when {condition} exceeded {value}.
entries.caution: 趋势描述要能被图直接看出。

en: One interpretation of this pattern is that {mechanism}.
This result is consistent with {theory}, which predicts {prediction}.
The observed effect may be attributable to {factor}, although {alternative} cannot be excluded.
entries.caution: 给出替代解释，显示你考虑过其他可能。

en: Our findings extend {author}'s result to {new setting}.
In contrast to {author}, who reported {finding}, we observed {finding}; the difference may stem from {reason}.
These results align with {author} but differ in {aspect}.
entries.caution: 比较要落到具体差异，不要只写「一致」。

en: Several limitations should be noted. First, {limitation}; second, {limitation}.
Our conclusions are restricted to {setting}, because {reason}.
The sample size ({n}) limits the precision of {estimate}.
entries.caution: 每条局限配一个缓解办法或后续验证方式。

en: A plausible mechanism is that {X} modulates {Y} through {pathway}.
Unexpectedly, {observation}; this suggests that {revised view}.
entries.caution: 机制推测必须标明是推测（may/might/could）。

en: Future work should test whether {X} holds in {other setting}.
Extending the approach to {case} is a natural next step.
A larger, multi-site study would help establish {claim}.
entries.caution: 具体到可执行，别写「进一步完善」。

en: This study shows that {claim} under {condition}.
Taken together, these results indicate that {claim}.
entries.caution: 不引入新数据、新概念。

en: The findings offer a practical basis for {application}.
Methodologically, the approach provides a way to {capability} without {cost}.
entries.caution: 意义不超过数据边界。

en: Applying the method to {domain} and validating it at scale are the next steps.
Whether the effect persists over longer periods remains an open question.
entries.caution: 展望要能落到一个可做的实验。

en: However, {X} remains unresolved.
In contrast, {Y} has received little attention.
entries.caution: 转折句通常就是空白的入口，善用。

en: Consequently, {X} cannot be assumed.
This, in turn, means that {Y}.
entries.caution: 因果要有依据，不要用 therefore 替代论证。

en: In addition, {X}.
Moreover, {Y} holds even when {condition}.
entries.caution: 并列观点用平行句式，读者才不必重新解析。

en: For example, {case} shows that {claim}.
A case in point is {case}.
entries.caution: 例子要服务于论点，不要变成故事。

en: We thank the reviewer for this observation. We have revised {location} accordingly.
The reviewer is right; we have added {content} on page {p}.
entries.caution: 逐条回应，标明修改位置。

en: We agree that {point} was unclear and have rephrased it as follows: {text}.
To avoid confusion, we now define {term} explicitly in Section {n}.
entries.caution: 先承认表述问题，再解释原意。

en: We respectfully disagree, because {evidence}. We have nevertheless added {clarification}.
Our data do not support this interpretation: {result}. We have made this explicit in {location}.
entries.caution: 给证据、给让步；不要情绪化。

en: We are grateful for the constructive comments, which have substantially improved the manuscript.
Below we respond point by point; reviewer comments are in italics.
entries.caution: 开头一段就交代修改范围与新增结果。
